I will keep this small root crop plot mostly the way I manage these small pieces when cash is tight. The plot is only 0.08 hectares, so buying chemical fertilizer for it does not fit me well unless I am sharing a bag, and this season I will use manure and my own planting material instead. I do not usually spray root crops on a plot like this, and I will depend on rain and family work from planting up to weeding and harvesting.
